newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Top Kazakh c.banker moved to securities commission.
newsitem.headline: Top Kazakh c.banker moved to securities commission.

text.p: President Nursultan Nazarbayev has appointed deputy central bank chairman Grigory Marchenko chairman of the National Securities Commission, state television said on Monday.
It was quoting a presidential decree in its main evening news programme.
Marchenko is an economist highly respected by Western bankers and investors, who credit him with a major role in stabilising the new tenge currency and bringing down inflation.
He has also been one of the main figures in managing the restructuring of Kazakhstan's banking sector, where he has presided over the closure of several troubled institutions.

At the securities commission he will oversee both the government securities market, which he helped launch at the central bank, and help develop the equities market, where trading volumes are still negligible.
